name: Ask More Photos popup — no free-text textarea
description: TC_AFP_C10. Guards the GJDT-22160 removal ('remove textarea not needed') for AI products: opening the Ask More Photos popup must not present a free-text textarea. A pure absence assertion — nothing is submitted and no OTP is sent.

placeholders.${product_url}: suite parameter — DesignTest JDMart product page under test

before.why: Load the AI product PDP under test
Confirm the CTA is present before opening the popup, so a failure on the absence assertion cannot be caused by the popup never opening

125.why: Confirm the popup actually opened. Without this, the textarea-absence assertion would pass trivially on a popup that never rendered.
Evidence of the popup contents at the moment of assertion

end.why: Evidence that the popup carries no free-text textarea

notes: popup_text_area is an ABSENCE GUARD, not an element locator: it resolves to 0 matches by design and is stored with _absence_guard true. It has no element DNA, so ML healing does not and cannot apply to it.

Selector is scoped to form[name='UserQuickInfo'] deliberately. The popup contains div.writtxtarea — a leftover class from the removed textarea that now wraps the PHONE INPUT. An unscoped [class*=txtarea] match would grab that wrapper and fail this test incorrectly.
Verified on the live DesignTest PDP: 0 textarea elements on the whole page, 0 inside the popup form. The testcase passes on the current build.
